CO-FA-*-*-*-*: Formalities at the beginning/Opening of the conversation
CO-FC-*-*-OPR-*: Offer to use the counselor’s professional resources
CO-IF-AC-RF-RPA-*: Request for previous attempts at solutions
CO-IF-Mot-*-IAC-*: Articulation of the perceived ability to change in the client (MI)
CO-IF-Mot-*-ITA-*: Thanks and appreciation to the client
CO-IF-RA-*-N-RAFa: Suggestion for resource activation at the family level
CO-IF-RA-*-N-RAFr: Suggestion for resource activation at the friendship level
CO-IF-RA-*-RAP-*: Suggestion for resource activation at professional level
CL-E-*-*-PT-*: Empathy for third parties or related to the present situation (PT)
CL-FB-*-*-*-*: Formalities at the beginning and greeting
CL-FC-*-*-UPR-*: Further use of professional resources of counselor
CL-IF-ACP-*-FPA-*: Feedback on previous attempts at solutions
CL-IF-HP-*-NegFR-*: Negative feedback on specific action recommendation
CL-IF-HP-*-PosFR-*: Positive feedback on specific recommendations for action
CL-IF-HP-*-RepRA-*: Report on the implementation of recommendations for action
CL-IF-Mot-*-RC-*: Articulation of reasons for a change in the client
CL-IF-RA-*-RF-*: Considering resource activation at the level of friends and family
CL-IF-RA-*-RP-*: Considering resource activation at a professional level
